biotools.summary: ROCKET is a Python program designed to facilitate the rational design of oligonucleotides for enhanced in vitro transcription. It utilizes thermodynamic parameters and performs folding-energy calculations to improve yields of template DNA and enhance tRNA transcript preparation.
